replies.author: steve_the_block
replies.body: Well, I can see that from your point of view, but this actually represents a time period of United States history when the US was trying to drive Native Americans out of their homeland to expand territory. Also, I  tried to be culturally and politically correct by doing some research on what each color represented and real names that existed to them. Also, I just now read that joke part, but I realized I might as well post this reply for other to see just in case they might have been offended. Thankz you :)

replies.author: steve_the_block
replies.body: Well I can see that, but since it's an army driving out Native Americans from their home, I figured a typical army would need a base to stay in since they're an army you know? I also thought that without the "strong" spawn, it would be just tents, port-a-potties, medical tents, and wagons. If you think that it's maybe too op, please tell me on ways to make it less strong. Also, when you say that the cowboys have houses to hide in, keep in mind that the buildings are small in area and exposed, and the other team also have their tipis to hide in too, but they are also not big in area. Also, I don't think the river is too much of a factor that favors anybody, because it's for detail and there is a log bridge to go over it. Also, I wasn't trying to make the cowboys' base op on purpose, but simply for detail. Sorry for the long response, but I just wanted to clear somethings. If you have any suggestions, please reply! Thank you :)

replies.author: TheMasterCow
replies.body:
[Denied] - I apologize, but your map has been denied for use on the Avicus Network and will not appear in either repository or rotations. Your map has been denied for the following reasons --
→ Too plain. How could you make it look more appealing?
→ Too rough. Could the terrain be more smooth?
→ Too advantageous. Could one team have a better chance at winning?
→ Too flat. Could you add more terrain or some more structure?
→ Chokepoint. Could you add more ways to get around other than the bridge?
